traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Ratfolk can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Rodent Empathy
traits.text: Ratfolk gain a +4 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks made to influence rodents.

traits.name: Swarming
traits.text: Ratfolk are used to living and fighting communally, and are adept at swarming foes for their own gain and their foes’ detriment. Up to two ratfolk can share the same square at the same time. If two ratfolk in the same square attack the same foe, they are considered to be flanking that foe as if they were in two opposite squares.

traits.name: Tinker
traits.text: Ratfolk gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy), Perception, and Use Magic Device checks.

alternate_traits.name: Surface Sprinter
alternate_traits.description: Some ratfolk spend as much time as they can aboveground and become very fast runners. This comes at the cost of their night vision, which becomes less acute after years of sunlight. These ratfolk gain low-light vision and have a base speed of 30 feet. This racial trait replaces darkvision and slow speed.

alternate_traits.name: Cleanliness
alternate_traits.description: Ratfolk strive to keep themselves and each other immaculately clean, to make it difficult for disease to spread. A ratfolk with this racial trait gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against disease, and whenever she exceeds the save DC to recover from a disease effect by 5 or more, she is treated as though she had succeeded at two consecutive saving throws. This racial trait replaces rodent empathy.

alternate_traits.name: Unnatural
alternate_traits.description: Some ratfolk unnerve normal animals, and train to defend themselves against the inevitable attacks from such creatures. These ratfolk take a –4 penalty on all Charisma-based skill checks to affect creatures of the animal type, and receive a +2 dodge bonus to AC against animals. An animal’s starting attitude toward ratfolk is one step worse than normal. This racial trait replaces rodent empathy.

alternate_traits.name: Cheek Pouches
alternate_traits.description: Some ratfolk have developed stretchy cheek pouches that they can use to hold and carry small loads up to 1 cubic foot in volume and 10 pounds in weight, such as light weapons, potions, scrolls, and similar objects. Such a ratfolk can transfer a held object to his cheek pouches or extract an object from his cheek pouches as a swift action. As a move action that provokes an attack of opportunity, the ratfolk can instead massage all of the items held in the cheek pouches onto the ground in the square it occupies. As long as the ratfolk has at least one object in its cheek pouches, its speech is difficult to understand, and it has a 20% spell failure chance when casting spells with verbal components. This racial trait replaces swarming.

alternate_traits.name: Cornered Fury
alternate_traits.description: Ratfolk can fight viciously when cut off from friends and allies. Whenever a ratfolk with this racial trait is reduced to half or fewer of his hit points, and has no conscious ally within 30 feet, he gains a +2 racial bonus on melee attack rolls and to Armor Class. This racial trait replaces swarming.

alternate_traits.name: Lab Rat
alternate_traits.description: For every ingenious ratfolk inventor, there is another who must inevitably test the invention. Those who survive enough experiments sometimes develop strange metabolic quirks that grant them heightened resilience and, on occasion, fortunate side effects when consuming alchemical or magical draughts. As a result, they gain a +1 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, alchemical weapons, and harmful effects from drinking potions or elixirs. In addition, once per day such a ratfolk can either increase the caster level of a potion he consumes by 1 or double the duration of an alchemical remedy he consumes or applies to himself (to a maximum of 4 hours). This racial trait replaces tinker.

alternate_traits.name: Market Dweller
alternate_traits.description: Some ratfolk, especially those of Deepmarket, are practiced at taking advantage of foes. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Bluff, Sense Motive, and Sleight of Hand checks. This racial trait replaces tinker.

alternate_traits.name: Scent
alternate_traits.description: Some ratfolk have much more strongly developed senses of smell, instead of keen eyes and ears. These ratfolk have the scent ability, but take a –2 penalty on all Perception checks based primarily on sight or hearing. This racial trait replaces tinker.

alternate_traits.name: Skulk
alternate_traits.description: Some ratfolk can blend easily into their environments, and move with surprising grace. Ratfolk gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks, and take only a –5 penalty on Stealth checks made to hide from creatures they have distracted with a Bluff check (rather than the normal –10 penalty). This racial trait replaces tinker.

favored_class_options.bonus: The alchemist gains +1/6 of a new discovery.
Add 1/3 to the number of times per day the arcanist can use the consume magic items exploit.
When raging, add +1/4 to the barbarian’s swarming trait’s flanking bonus on attack rolls.
Increase the bonus provided by the bard’s inspire competence performance by 1/6, and add 1/6 to the number of allies the bard can affect with his inspire greatness performance.
Add a +1 bonus on wild empathy checks made to influence animals and magical beasts that live underground.
Add +1 to the fighter’s CMD when resisting a bull rush or grapple attempt.
Add a +1/2 bonus on initiative checks when the gunslinger has at least 1 grit point.
Add 1 skill rank to the hunter’s badger, dire rat, or riding rat ( ) animal companion.
Add 1/2 to Sense Motive checks and Knowledge (dungeoneering) checks to identify creatures.

Add 1 to the bonus provided to a single skill (maximum +2) by inspiration. This skill must be one to which the investigator can already apply inspiration. The investigator can select a different skill at each level.
Gain a +1 bonus on concentration checks to maintain the mesmerist’s hypnotic stare.

Add +1 feet to the speed the monk can move while making a Stealth check without taking a penalty. This has no effect unless the monk has selected this reward five times (or another increment of five). This does not allow the monk to use Stealth while running or charging.
Gain 1/6 of a new focus power.
Gain 1/6 of a new phrenic amplification.
Add +1 to an animal companion’s CMD when adjacent to the ranger. If the ranger ever replaces his animal companion, the new animal companion gains this bonus.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Escape Artist checks.
Add a +1 bonus on wild empathy checks to influence animals and magical beasts that live underground.
Add 1/2 hit point and 1/2 skill point to the spiritualist’s phantom.
Add a +1 bonus on saving throws against poison made by the summoner’s eidolon.
Add 1/4 to the AC bonus provided by cover or improved cover.
Add +5 feet to the range of one hex with a range other than "touch.".

entries.name: Reborn Samsaran
entries.description: Reborn Samsaran: modificatori {'int': 2, 'wis': 2, 'con': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Low-Light Vision; Psychic Attunement; Reborn Magic; Special Qualities.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Reborn samsarans can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Psychic Attunement
traits.text: Reborn samsarans receive Psychic Virtuoso as a bonus feat at 1st level. Those who can’t use occult skill unlocks at 1st level instead gain the Psychic Sensitivity feat as a bonus feat.

traits.name: Reborn Magic
traits.text: A reborn samsaran with a Charisma score of 11 or higher can cast the following spells (as per the psychic magic universal monster rule [see page 2], using his Charisma modifier to determine the DCs): burst of insightOA (1 PE), detect psychic significanceOA (0 PE), object readingOA (2 PE), and psychic readingOA (1 PE). The caster level is equal to the reborn samsaran’s level. The reborn samsaran has a reservoir of 5 PE per day.

traits.name: Special Qualities
traits.text: A reborn samsaran gains the following special qualities.

entries.name: Reptoid
entries.description: Reptoid: modificatori {'str': 2, 'cha': 2, 'dex': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Humanoid; Low-Light Vision (Ex); Scales; Cold-Blooded (Ex); Natural Weapons (Ex); Change Shape (Su); Mental Potency (Ex).

traits.name: Humanoid
traits.text: Reptoids are humanoids with the reptilian and shapechanges subtypes.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision (Ex)
traits.text: Reptoids can see twice as far as humans in dim light.

traits.name: Scales
traits.text: When in its natural form, a reptoid has a +1 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Cold-Blooded (Ex)
traits.text: Reptoids receive a +2 racial saving throw bonus against mind-affecting effects and poison.

traits.name: Natural Weapons (Ex)
traits.text: When in its natural form, a reptoid has a bite attack and two claw attacks that deal 1d3 points of damage each.

traits.name: Change Shape (Su)
traits.text: A reptoid can assume the appearance of a specific single Medium humanoid. The reptoid always takes this specific form when it uses this ability. The reptoid gains a +10 racial bonus on Disguise checks to appear as that type of humanoid. This ability otherwise functions as alter self, except the reptoid does not adjust its ability scores. A reptoid can select a new humanoid form by spending 1 week preparing itself for the change, but can then no longer assume its previous humanoid form.

traits.name: Mental Potency (Ex)
traits.text: A reptoid’s mental effects can affect more powerful creatures or a greater number of creatures than normal. Both the Hit Die limit and the total number of Hit Dice affected by each enchantment or illusion spell it casts increase by 1. For enchantment and illusion spells it casts that target a number of creatures greater than one, the number of creatures affected also increases by one (so a spell that targets one creature per level would be affected, but a spell that targets only one creature would not be). This ability stacks with the mesmerist’s ability of the same name.

entries.name: Rougarou
entries.description: Rougarou: modificatori {'str': 2, 'wis': 2, 'int': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Senses; Change Shape (Su); Natural Weapon.

traits.name: Senses
traits.text: Rougarous have low-light vision and the scent special ability.

traits.name: Change Shape (Su)
traits.text: A rougarou can change shape once per day into a wolf as a standard action, as beast shape I. A rougarou can revert to its true form as a swift action.

traits.name: Natural Weapon
traits.text: Rougarous have a bite attack that deals 1d4 points of damage. This is a secondary attack if a rougarou wields a manufactured weapon.

auto: their own racial language of Rougarou

entries.name: Sahuagin
entries.description: Sahuagin: modificatori {'str': 2, 'wis': 2, 'cha': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Monstrous Humanoid; Blindsense; Darkvision; Light Blindness; Natural Armor; Fast Swimmer (5 RP); Bite; Claws; Blood Frenzy; Speak with Sharks (1 RP).

traits.name: Monstrous Humanoid
traits.text: Sahuagin are monstrous humanoids with the aquatic subtype.

traits.name: Blindsense
traits.text: Sahuagin have blindsense with a range of 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Sahuagin have darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Light Blindness
traits.text: Sahuagin have the light blindness trait.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Sahuagin have a +3 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Fast Swimmer (5 RP)
traits.text: Sahuagin have a swim speed of 60 feet.

traits.name: Bite
traits.text: Sahuagin have a natural bite attack that deals 1d4 points of damage. This bite is a primary attack, or a secondary attack if the creature is wielding manufactured weapons.

traits.name: Claws
traits.text: Sahuagin have two claw attacks that deal 1d4 points of damage. These are primary natural attacks.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.text: Once per day, whenever a sahuagin takes damage, it can fly into a frenzy for 1 minute; gaining a +2 racial bonus to Constitution and Strength but a –2 penalty to AC.

traits.name: Speak with Sharks (1 RP)
traits.text: Sahuagin can communicate telepathically with sharks to a distance of 100 feet. This communication is limited to simple concepts, such as “attack,” “come,” and “defend.”

subraces.name: Outsear Sahuagin
subraces.description: The settlement of Outsea is a bizarre environment: a saltwater oasis for merfolk and sahuagin in the freshwater River Kingdoms. Centuries ago, a sahuagin nation from the inner sea region mobilized a city-sized saltwater bolus for an overland assault on a merfolk state located near modern-day a port city. The merfolk learned of this ambitious plan and sent an elite group of soldiers in saltwater tanks to intercept the ocean-bubble. The two sides clashed in Lake Encarthan and eventually worked their way up into what is now the River Kingdoms. In this battle, many of the wizards maintaining the sahuagin’s briny mobile fortress perished, and the two sides ended up stranded hundreds of miles from any ocean. Begrudgingly putting aside their grievances, the merfolk and sahuagin worked together to prevent their mutual extinction, holding back the fresh water with spells and building the settlement of Outsea to serve as a permanent home. Now Outsea is a thriving city, home to all kinds of peoples. Centuries of coexistence have worn down the merfolk and sahuagin’s hatred for each other, and now they live and work together in peace. Outsear sahuagin can take the sahuagin song and stoic defender alternate racial traits described below.

alternate_traits.name: Stoic Defender
alternate_traits.description: Outsear sahuagin have learned to control their aggression, standing as reliable guards of the city they are proud to call home. Once per day when a sahuagin with this racial trait takes damage, he can focus on remaining steadfast for the good of Outsea. For 1 minute, the sahuagin gains a +2 racial bonus to AC and a +2 racial bonus on Will saves. This replaces blood frenzy.

alternate_traits.name: Sahuagin Song
alternate_traits.description: While Outsear sahuagin typically don’t have a history of music, over the years the merfolk of the city have shared their love of song with them. Sahuagin with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Perform (sing) checks and a +1 racial bonus on saves against language-dependent effects. This replaces speak with sharks.

entries.name: Skinwalker
entries.description: Skinwalker: modificatori {'wis': 2, 'int': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Low-Light Vision; Spell-Like Ability; Animal-Minded; Change Shape (Su).

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Skinwalkers can see twice as far as humans can in dim light.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability
traits.text: A skinwalker with a Wisdom score of 11 or higher can use speak with animals once per day as a spell-like ability, using his Wisdom modifier to determine his concentration checks. The caster level for this ability is equal to the skinwalker's character level.

traits.name: Animal-Minded
traits.text: Skinwalkers have a +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks and on wild empathy checks.

traits.name: Change Shape (Su)
traits.text: A skinwalker can change shape to a bestial form as a standard action. In bestial form, a skinwalker gains a +2 racial bonus to his choice of Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. While in this form, a skinwalker also takes on an animalistic feature that provides a special effect. Each time a skinwalker assumes bestial form, he can choose to gain two claw attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage, 60 foot darkvision, or a +1 natural armor bonus. These benefits last until the skinwalker returns to his humanoid form as a swift action. A skinwalker must first return to his humanoid form before changing to bestial form again to change benefits.

subraces.name: Werebat-Kin (Bloodmarked)
subraces.description: These skinwalkers are usually communal and defer readily to their superiors. They prefer dwelling in areas of dense foliage, such as jungles or forests. They often have little trust for those not in their immediate clan. +2 Intelligence, –2 Wisdom (+2 Dexterity while shapechanged) Fly, Perception at night 1/day Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage +4 racial bonus on Perception checks Scent to a range of 30 feet Treat falling damage as if the distance fallen were 20 feet less than it actually is

subraces.name: Werebear-Kin (Coldborn)
subraces.description: Known and respected as the defenders of the wild in many parts of the Lands of the Linnorm Kings, these skinwalkers often prefer to live as recluses. +2 Constitution, –2 Charisma (+2 Wisdom while shapechanged) Climb, wild empathy 1/day Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage 2 claw attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage Climb speed of 20 feet Scent to a range of 30 feet

subraces.name: Wereboar-Kin (Ragebred)
subraces.description: These skinwalkers are known for their fiery tempers and stubborn streaks, features that have earned them respect in remote corners of Garund, a diabolic empire, and a frontier land as freedom fighters. +2 Strength, –2 Charisma (+2 Constitution while shapechanged) Handle Animal, Perception (pigs and boars only) 3/day +10 foot racial bonus to base speed Gore attack that deals 1d6 points of damage 2 hoof attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage Scent to a range of 30 feet

subraces.name: Werecrocodile-Kin (Scaleheart)
subraces.description: Found most often in areas such as the Shackles and the a storm-ravaged coast, these skinwalkers are often brutish and cruel. +2 Constitution, –2 Wisdom (+2 Strength while shapechanged) Stealth, wild empathy 1/day Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage Darkvision to a range of 60 feet Swim speed of 30 feet

subraces.name: Wereraptor-Kin (Aerieborn)
subraces.description: wereraptor LN +2 Wis, –2 Cha (+2 Dex while shapechanged) Perception, Sense Motive 1/day Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage 2 talon attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage +4 racial bonus on Perception checks Increase fly speeds from other sources by 10 feet

subraces.name: Wererat-Kin (Nightskulk)
subraces.description: These creatures, who are among the more common of the skinwalkers, prefer to dwell in urban areas. +2 Intelligence, –2 Strength (+2 Dexterity while shapechanged) Handle Animal, Stealth in urban environments (rodents only) 3/day Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage Climb speed of 30 feet (except with only one chosen natural attack per round, and sickens instead of nauseates). Scent to a range of 30 feet

subraces.name: Wereshark-Kin (Seascarred)
subraces.description: These unusual skinwalkers tend to be strong-willed and brisk in their patterns of speech. They often serve aboard pirate ships, where their traits are well appreciated. +2 Wisdom, –2 Intelligence (+2 Constitution while shapechanged) Perception, Swim (aquatic animals only) 3/day Breathe water as well as air Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage Swim speed of 30 feet

subraces.name: Weretiger-Kin (Fanglord)
subraces.description: More common in a distant continent than the inner sea region, these skinwalkers are notorious for their fickle attitudes. +2 Dexterity, –2 Wisdom (+2 Charisma while shapechanged) Acrobatics, Perception 1/day Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage 2 claw attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage +10-foot racial bonus to base speed

subraces.name: Werewolf-Kin (Witchwolf)
subraces.description: Perhaps the most prevalent breed of skinwalker, witchwolves prefer dwelling with others of their kind. +2 Constitution, –2 Intelligence (+2 Wisdom while shapechanged) Perception, wild empathy 1/day Bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage 2 claw attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage Darkvision 60 feet +2 racial bonus on all saving throws

alternate_traits.name: Beast Talker
replaces: Alters Change Shape and Spell-like Ability
alternate_traits.description: Some skinwalkers’ ability to communicate with animals is stronger than their ability to transform. Such skinwalkers can only use their change shape ability once per day for 1 minute per level, but they can use their spell-like ability at will. This racial trait alters the change shape and spell-like ability racial traits.

entries.name: Svirfneblin
entries.description: Svirfneblin: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'wis': 2, 'str': -2, 'cha': -4}, taglia Small, velocita' 20 ft. Tratti razziali: Gnome; Defensive Training; Senses; Fortunate; Skilled; Hatred; Stonecunning; Spell Resistance; Svirfneblin Magic.

traits.name: Gnome
traits.text: Svirfneblin are humanoids with the gnome subtype.

traits.name: Defensive Training
traits.text: Svirfneblin gain a +2 dodge bonus to their AC.

traits.name: Senses
traits.text: Svirfneblin have darkvision 120 feet and lowlight vision.

traits.name: Fortunate
traits.text: Svirfneblin gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws.

traits.name: Skilled
traits.text: Svirfneblin gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks; this improves to a +4 bonus underground. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks and Perception checks.

traits.name: Hatred
traits.text: Svirfneblin receive a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the reptilian and dwarf subtypes due to training against these hated foes.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.text: Svirfneblin gain the stonecunning trait as dwarves.

traits.name: Spell Resistance
traits.text: A svirfneblin has an amount of spell resistance equal to 11 + his character level.

traits.name: Svirfneblin Magic
traits.text: Svirfneblin add 1 to the DCs of any saving throws to resist illusion spells they cast. Svirfneblin also gain the following spell-like abilities: constant—nondetection; 1/day—blindness/deafness (DC 12 + Charisma modifier), blur, disguise self; caster level equals the svirfneblin’s character level.

alternate_traits.name: Healthy
alternate_traits.description: Svirfneblin gain a +4 bonus on Fortitude saves against disease and poison, including magical diseases. This racial trait replaces fortunate.

alternate_traits.name: Stalwart Watcher
alternate_traits.description: Svirfneblin first came to the world to thwart the schemes of evil fey. Those who still keep to this mission, primarily dwelling in settlements far beneath a free nation, gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against fey creatures and a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects. This racial trait replaces hatred and skilled.

alternate_traits.name: Stoneseer
alternate_traits.description: Svirfneblin add +1 to the caster level of any spells with the earth descriptor they cast. Svirfneblin also gain the following spell-like abilities: Constant— ; 1/day— , , ; caster level equals the svirfneblin’s class levels. This racial trait replaces svirfneblin magic.

favored_class_options.bonus: Add one extract formula from the alchemist’s list to the alchemist’s formula book. This formula must be at least one level below the highest formula level the alchemist can create.
Add one spell known from the oracle spell list. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level the oracle can cast.

Add DR 1/magic to the ranger’s animal companion. Each additional time the ranger selects this benefit, the DR/magic increases +1/2 (maximum DR 10/magic). If the ranger ever replaces his animal companion, the new companion gains this DR.

entries.name: Syrinx
entries.description: Syrinx: modificatori {'wis': 2, 'dex': -2}, taglia None, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Flight; Low-Light Vision; Darkvision; Nocturnal; Pride; Speak with Avians.

traits.name: Flight
traits.text: Syrinxes have a fly speed of 60 feet with average maneuverability.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Syrinxes can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Syrinxes can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Nocturnal
traits.text: Syrinxes gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks at night.

traits.name: Pride
traits.text: Syrinxes receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects.

traits.name: Speak with Avians
traits.text: Syrinxes can speak with all birds of the animal creature type and birdlike magical beasts (such as phoenixes and thunderbirds).

alternate_traits.name: Oppressive
alternate_traits.description: Syrinxes often have a natural talent for sensing how to unsettle and oppress other creatures. As a swift action, a syrinx can attempt a Sense Motive check against a DC of 10 + a creature’s Hit Dice + its Charisma modifier or a DC of 10 + the creature’s Bluff modifier, whichever is higher. On a success, syrinx gains a +4 racial bonus on Intimidate checks against that target and a +1 racial bonus to the DC of any fear effects she uses against that target. This racial trait replaces nocturnal and pride.

entries.name: Triton
entries.description: Triton: modificatori {'str': 2, 'cha': 2, 'dex': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 5 ft. Tratti razziali: Outsider; Darkvision; Low-Light Vision; Natural Armor; Swim Speed; Spell-Like Ability.

traits.name: Outsider
traits.text: Tritons are native outsiders with the water subtype.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Tritons have darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Tritons have low-light vision.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Tritons have a +2 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Swim Speed
traits.text: Tritons have a swim speed of 40 feet.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability
traits.text: Tritons can cast summon nature’s ally II once per day to summon either a Small water elemental or 1d3 dolphins only.

entries.name: Trox
entries.description: Trox: modificatori {'str': 6, 'int': -2, 'wis': -2, 'cha': -2}, taglia Large, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Monstrous Humanoid; Darkvision; Burrow; Frenzy; Grabbing Appendages.

traits.name: Monstrous Humanoid
traits.text: Trox are monstrous humanoids.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Trox can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Burrow
traits.text: Trox have a burrow speed of 20 feet.

traits.name: Frenzy
traits.text: Once per day when a trox takes damage, it flies into a frenzy for 1 minute, gaining a +2 racial bonus to Constitution and Strength, but a –2 penalty to their AC.

traits.name: Grabbing Appendages
traits.text: A trox’s smaller arms are useful for little more than aiding it with grappling. Trox gain Improved Grapple as a bonus feat, and can maintain a grapple and still make attacks with their main arms.

alternate_traits.name: Tremorsense
alternate_traits.description: Some trox have developed a closeness to the earth that helps them thwart the invisibility of their duergar enemies. They gain tremorsense to a range of 30 feet. This racial trait replaces frenzy and burrow.

entries.name: Undine
entries.description: Undine: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'wis': 2, 'str': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Native Outsider; Darkvision; Spell-Like Ability; Energy Resistance; Water Affinity.

traits.name: Native Outsider
traits.text: Undines are outsiders with the native subtype.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Undines can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability
traits.text: Undines can cast hydraulic push once per day as a spell-like ability (with a caster level equal to the undine’s character level).

traits.name: Energy Resistance
traits.text: Undines have cold resistance 5.

traits.name: Water Affinity
traits.text: Undine sorcerers with the elemental (water) bloodline treat their Charisma scores as 2 points higher for the purposes of all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Undine clerics with the Water domain cast their Water domain powers and spells at +1 caster level.

subraces.name: Mistsoul (Vapor Undine)
subraces.description: Soothing and insightful, mistsoul undines move through the world with airy resilience and earnest action. NG +2 Con, +2 Wis, –2 Int Mistsouls gain as a spell-like ability. This racial trait functions as and can be replaced as the base undine’s water affinity, except it benefits sorcerers with the dreamspun bloodline and spellcasters with the Repose domain. With gentle spirits and contemplative minds, mistsouls are drawn to the more mystic aspects of their element. Their ephemeral, vaporous natures can allow them to lull others into a dreamlike state, or facilitate a peaceful transition into the next life. They tend to seek out places where ideological and political struggles converge, and thus they are at home in communities like those of the common folk of Brevoy. Physically, mistsouls have rounded features and graceful deliberation in their movement. They prefer soft, highquality garments of neutral or earth tones and simple jewelry chosen for significance rather than expense.

subraces.name: Rimesoul (Frost Undine)
subraces.description: Rimesoul undines are distant and imperious, aloof in their intellect and hesitant to change their ways. LN +2 Dex, +2 Int, –2 Cha Rimesouls gain as a spell-like ability. This racial trait functions as and can be replaced as the base undine’s water affinity, except it benefits sorcerers with the boreal bloodline and spellcasters with the Ice subdomain. Like their ice-coated ancestors, rimesouls represent the solidification of change. They have precise, ordered minds that take well to individual pursuits. Rimesouls often choose to live in sparsely populated areas in a winter-locked realm and a frontier land. When they do live in cities, they prefer areas of disciplined culture such as a merchant principality and a diabolic empire. In appearance, rimesouls are frequently pale, sometimes with translucent or blue-tinged skin. Rimesouls usually dress in crisp, understated fashions that present an impression of austerity.

alternate_traits.name: Deepsight
alternate_traits.description: The eyes of some undines are especially adapted to the lightless depths of the oceans, but not to air-filled environments. An undine with this racial trait has darkvision 120 feet when underwater, but otherwise has no darkvision at all. This racial trait replaces darkvision.

alternate_traits.name: Flesh Chameleon
alternate_traits.description: Some undines can change their coloration to match human skin tones. As a standard action, an undine with this racial trait can change her natural blue hue to match any normal human skin tone, and can revert to normal as a free action. This grants a +4 racial bonus on Disguise checks to appear human. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.

alternate_traits.name: Terrain Chameleon
alternate_traits.description: Some undines can change their coloration to blend in with underwater terrain, mixing browns, grays, and greens to resemble kelp or other natural water plants. As a standard action, an undine with this racial trait can change her coloration, gaining a +4 bonus on Stealth checks in underwater environments. She can return to normal as a free action. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.

alternate_traits.name: Water Sense
alternate_traits.description: Undines with this racial trait can sense vibrations in water, granting them blindsense 30 feet against creatures in contact with the same body of water. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.

alternate_traits.name: Mostly Human
alternate_traits.description: A few ifrits, oreads, sulis, sylphs, and undines have appearances much closer to those of their human ancestors; in fact, they may not even realize their true race. Such geniekin appear to be human, save perhaps minor features like unusual eye color, and they count as humanoid (human) as well as outsider (native) for all purposes (such as humanoid-affecting spells such as or ). These geniekin do not automatically gain their associated elemental language (but may select it as a bonus language if their Intelligence is high enough). This ability alters the geniekin’s type, subtype, and languages.

alternate_traits.name: Acid Breath
alternate_traits.description: Undines whose outsider heritage can be traced to a water mephit can wield acid as a weapon. Such an undine has a breath weapon that is a 5-foot cone of acidic water usable once per day. The breath deals 1d8 points of acid damage per two character levels (maximum 5d8). A Reflex saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 the undine’s level + the undine’s Constitution modifier) halves the damage. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternate_traits.name: Amphibious
alternate_traits.description: Some undines are born with a permanent bond to water. Undines with this racial trait gain the aquatic subtype and amphibious special quality. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternate_traits.name: Nereid Fascination
alternate_traits.description: Some undines can trace their ancestry to nereids as well as to outsiders. Once per day as a standard action, such an undine can create a 20-foot-radius aura that causes humanoids within the aura’s range to become fascinated with her for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 the undine’s character level (minimum 1). Targets may resist with a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the undine’s level + the undine’s Charisma modifier). This is a supernatural ability. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternate_traits.name: Ooze Breath
alternate_traits.description: Some undines’ outsider heritage can be traced to ooze mephits. These undines have a breath weapon that is a 5-foot cone of slime usable once per day. The slime deals 1d4 points of acid damage per two character levels (maximum 5d4) and sickens creatures in the area for 3 rounds. A successful Reflex saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 the undine’s level + the undine’s Constitution modifier) halves the damage and negates the sickened effect. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternate_traits.name: Triton Magic
alternate_traits.description: Some undines—often from Outsea—descend from tritons, rather than genies. Undines with this racial trait can use as a spell-like ability, but only to summon a dolphin. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternate_traits.name: Hydrated Vitality
alternate_traits.description: An undine with this racial trait gains fast healing 2 for 1 round anytime she submerges completely within a body of natural salt water, fresh water, or brackish water. Stagnant, poisoned, or trapped water (such as an artificial pit or a ) does not activate this ability. The undine can heal up to 2 hit points per level per day with this ability, after which it ceases to function. This racial trait replaces water affinity.

favored_class_options.bonus: Add a +1 bonus on Perform checks to use the countersong bardic performance against creatures with the aquatic or water subtypes.
Add a +1 bonus on caster level checks to overcome the spell resistance of creatures with the aquatic or water subtype.
Add a +1 bonus on wild empathy checks to influence animals and magical beasts with the aquatic subtype.
Add +1 to the monk’s CMD when resisting a grapple and +1/3 to the number of stunning attacks he can attempt per day.
Add a +1 bonus on wild empathy checks to influence animals and magical beasts with the aquatic subtype.
Add a +1 bonus on caster level checks to cast spells underwater.
If the summoner’s eidolon has an aquatic base form , add +5 feet to the range of the summoner’s life link ability.

Add one spell from the cleric, druid, or wizard spell list with the water descriptor to the wizard’s spellbook. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level he can cast. This spell is treated as one level higher unless it also appears on the wizard spell list.

entries.name: Vine Leshy
entries.description: Vine Leshy: modificatori {'con': 2, 'wis': 2, 'int': -2}, taglia Small, velocita' 20 ft. Tratti razziali: Leshy; Darkvision; Low-Light Vision; Pass without Trace; Change Shape; Plantspeech; Verdant Burst; Unassuming Foliage; Climber.

traits.name: Leshy
traits.text: Vine leshys are plants with the leshy subtype but lack the immunities to mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep, and stunning that the plant type usually grants, and they lack the immunity to electricity and sonic that the leshy subtype usually grants.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Vine leshys can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Vine leshys can see twice as far as humans under conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Pass without Trace
traits.text: Vine leshys have pass without trace as a constant spell-like ability (caster level 2nd).

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.text: Vine leshys can transform into vines, with results similar to tree shape. In this form, the leshy appears as a particularly healthy Small vine. The leshy can assume plant form or revert to its true form as a swift action.

traits.name: Plantspeech
traits.text: Vine leshys can speak with vines as if subject to a continual speak with plants spell.

traits.name: Verdant Burst
traits.text: When slain, a vine leshy explodes in a burst of fertile energies. All plant creatures within 30 feet of the slain leshy regain hit 1d8 points, and vines quickly infest the area. If the terrain can support vines, the undergrowth is dense enough to make the region into difficult terrain for 24 hours, after which the plant life diminishes to a normal level; otherwise, this plant life has no significant effect on movement and withers and dies within an hour.

traits.name: Unassuming Foliage
traits.text: Vine leshys gain a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks in forests.

traits.name: Climber
traits.text: Vine leshys gain a +2 racial bonus on Climb checks.

alternate_traits.name: Grapevine
alternate_traits.description: A vine leshy made from a grapevine can produce magically infused fruit that can heal her allies. She can cast once per day as a spell-like ability, with a caster level equal to her character level. This replaces .

alternate_traits.name: Agile
alternate_traits.description: Agile vine leshys are quicker but less tough than a typical vine leshy. Replace the leshy’s +2 racial bonus to Constitution with a +2 racial bonus to Dexterity. This alters the vine leshy’s ability scores.

alternate_traits.name: Lashvine
alternate_traits.description: Some vine leshys can sprout whip-like appendages. These individuals gain proficiency with whips and scorpion whips. As a free action, the vine leshy can turn one hand into a lashvine. A lashvine is a primary natural attack that deals 1d3 points of bludgeoning damage. A lashvine cannot hold items, wield weapons, or perform fine manipulation. This replaces change shape and verdant burst.

alternate_traits.name: Seasoned Spirit
alternate_traits.description: Long-lived vine leshys are less flexible, but they have established stronger bonds with the natural world. These leshys can spend an hour in concentration to cast as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to their character level. This alters plantspeech and replaces climber and unassuming foliage.

alternate_traits.name: Swamp Leshy
alternate_traits.description: Some vine leshys are made from plants that naturally grow in swamps. These leshys gain a +2 racial bonus on Swim checks and a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks in swamps. This replaces climber and alters unassuming foliage.

alternate_traits.name: Writhing Eye
alternate_traits.description: Some vine leshys can grow thin vines that serve as sensory organs. Growing or controlling the vine is a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity. The vine can extend up to 15 feet and is small enough to pass through a keyhole. A leshy can perceive, using all of her senses, within 20 feet of the vine’s tip. This replaces darkvision and low-light vision.

alternate_traits.name: Curiosity
alternate_traits.description: Vine leshys bearing gregarious spirits are more suited to learn about other cultures. They always treat Diplomacy and Linguistics as class skills, and they gain a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Linguistics checks. This replaces pass without trace and plantspeech.

alternate_traits.name: Poisonous
alternate_traits.description: Vine leshys made from poison ivy vines carry natural poison in their bodies. As a swift action, the leshy can imbue its vines with this irritating substance. The next time the leshy hits a creature with an unarmed strike, the creature is affected by the following poison. : Unarmed strike—injury; Fort DC 10 + half the vine leshy’s Hit Dice + the leshy’s Constitution modifier; 1/round for 6 rounds; sickened for 1 round; cure 1 save. The leshy can use this ability a number of times per day equal to its Constitution modifier (minimum 1). A vine leshy is immune to its own poison, but not to those of other vine leshys. This replaces plantspeech and change shape.

favored_class_options.bonus: Add 1/4 to the alchemist’s natural armor bonus when using his mutagen.
Add a +1/3 bonus to Perform (oratory) checks, including checks using versatile performance, as long as the bard first spends at least 10 minutes telling a story.
Add a +1/2 bonus to the druid’s wild empathy or plant empathy checks.
Gain 1/5 of the Extra Wild Talent feat. This feat must be spent on a wood-element talent.

An oracle with the nature or wood mystery adds one spell from the druid’s spell list that isn’t on the cleric spell list to the oracle’s spell list; she still must select this spell as one of her spells known in order to cast it. This spell must be at least 1 level lower than the highest spell level the oracle can cast.
Add a +1/2 bonus to Knowledge (nature) checks in the ranger’s favored terrain.
Add a +1/2 bonus to Climb checks and on Stealth checks in forests.

Shamans with the nature or wood spirit add one spell from the druid’s spell list that isn’t on the shaman spell list to the shaman’s spell list; she still must select this spell as one of her spells known in order to cast it. This spell must be at least 1 level lower than the highest spell level the shaman can cast.
Add a +1 bonus on Knowledge (nature) checks relating to plants.

entries.name: Wyrwood
entries.description: Wyrwood: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'int': 2, 'cha': -2}, taglia Small, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Construct; Darkvision; Low-Light Vision.

traits.name: Construct
traits.text: Wyrwoods have the construct type.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Wyrwoods can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Wyrwoods have low-light vision.

alternate_traits.name: Repair Magic
alternate_traits.description: Some wyrwoods have developed magic to keep them more self-sufficient. They can use as a spell-like ability once per day. This racial trait replaces darkvision.

alternate_traits.name: Experimental Body
alternate_traits.description: Some wyrwoods have been built from rare materials in an effort to imbue them with special properties. Choose one of the following abilities. : These wyrwoods contain divine relics. Wyrwoods with this trait can use once per day as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to their Hit Dice. : Crafted from the remnants of broken staves, wands and other items, these wyrwoods have a natural attunement to the arcane. Wyrwoods with this trait treat their Intelligence score as 2 higher for the purpose of determining bonus spells or extracts per day. : These wyrwoods have components that create a powerful link to the First World. Wyrwoods with this trait can use once per day as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to their Hit Dice. : These wyrwoods are built from the ruins of cities and structures destroyed by conflict. Once per day, after a successful melee attack against an enemy, wyrwoods with this trait can deal an additional number of points of damage equal to their Wisdom modifier as a free action. This replaces darkvision and low-light vision.

alternate_traits.name: Living Machine
alternate_traits.description: Through generations of refining the techniques of creation, many young wyrwoods have become closer to organic beings than constructs. These wyrwoods are constructs with the living machine subtype. They gain a Constitution score and can be targeted by spells and effects that target living creatures or constructs, as well as those that require a Fortitude save. They are no longer immune to ability damage, ability drain, energy drain, exhaustion, or fatigue. Wyrwoods with this trait require sleep, but they do not need to breathe or eat. They are not destroyed when reduced to 0 hit points, instead becoming unconscious and stable. They are destroyed when reduced to a negative number of hit points equal to their Constitution score. They can be raised or resurrected when destroyed. This alters the wyrwood’s creature type.

favored_class_options.bonus: Reduce the mental ability score penalty of the alchemist’s mutagens by 1/5 (minimum 0).
Add 1/4 to the arcanist’s level for the spell resistance exploit.
Add 1/4 to the cleric’s caster level when casting spells or using abilities from the Law domain or one of its subdomains, or when casting spells with the lawful descriptor.
Add 2 rounds to the duration of the magus’ arcane pool enhancements.

Add one spell known from the wizard’s evocation school spell list. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest-level spell the oracle can cast. That spell is treated as 1 level higher unless it is also on the oracle spell list.
The paladin gains 1/4 of a bonus spell per day of the highest-level spell that the paladin can cast.
psychic gains 1/6 of a phrenic amplification.
The rogue gains 1/6 of a rogue talent.
The slayer gains 1/6 of a slayer talent.
The wizard gains 1/6 of a bonus , , or spell mastery feat.

entries.name: Wyvaran
entries.description: Wyvaran: modificatori {'dex': 2, 'wis': 2, 'int': -2}, taglia Medium, velocita' 30 ft. Tratti razziali: Dragon; Flight; Slapping Tail; Darkvision; Low-Light Vision.

traits.name: Dragon
traits.text: Wyvarans have the dragon type.

traits.name: Flight
traits.text: Wyvarans have dragonlike wings that grant them a fly speed of 30 feet with clumsy maneuverability.

traits.name: Slapping Tail
traits.text: Wyvarans have a tail attack they can use only when making attacks of opportunity. This slapping tail attack deals a number of points of damage equal to 1d8 + the wyvaran’s Strength modifier.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Wyvarans can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Wyvarans have low-light vision.

alternate_traits.name: Evasive Maneuvers
alternate_traits.description: Coastal wyvarans often take to the air to defend their territory from intruding ships, and are forced to learn aerial maneuvers to avoid siege fire. They fly with an average maneuverability instead of clumsy, and they gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC and on Reflex saving throws against siege weapons. This racial trait replaces darkvision and slapping tail.

alternate_traits.name: Memories of the Forgotten
alternate_traits.description: Generations of wyvaran elders pass down tales that predate written history. While many ignore these or dismiss them as simple stories, others revere the lore of their elders. These wyvarans consider it their sacred duty to study the lost histories and pass them down to others. They gain a +2 racial bonus on two Knowledge skills of their choice. Those Knowledge skills are class skills for them. This racial trait replaces flight.

alternate_traits.name: Vestigal Wings
alternate_traits.description: When resources are particularly scarce, some young wyvarans develop smaller-than-average wings incapable of flight. However, these wings are perfectly suited for other acrobatic maneuvers. These wyvarans gain a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks, and one of these is a class skill for them. In addition, they can ignore the first 20 feet of falling damage when they make a successful Acrobatics check. This racial trait replaces flight.

alternate_traits.name: Neglected Heritage
alternate_traits.description: Because of their dwindling population and cultural stagnation, some wyvarans have given up on their people, favoring a life among other races instead. These wyvarans lose Draconic as a starting language, but gain a +1 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks when making requests and gathering information. They can’t take Draconic as a bonus language, but can learn it normally with Linguistics. This ability alters the wyvaran’s languages.

alternate_traits.name: Greed
alternate_traits.description: Most wyvarans crave treasure, but for some, amassing wealth is a compulsion. Wyvarans with this trait gain a +2 on racial bonus on Appraise checks, and Appraise is a class skill for them. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Sleight of Hand checks when attempting to take items from other creatures. They can also use their tails to attempt these Sleight of Hand checks. This racial trait replaces slapping tail.

favored_class_options.bonus: Add 1 to the bloodrager’s total rounds of bloodrage each day.
Add 1/4 to the mesmerist’s level for the purpose of determining the effect of mesmerist tricks.
Add 1/4 to the oracle’s level for the purpose of determining the effects of an oracle curse.
Add 1/2 to the paladin’s level when determining the effect of smite evil against evil-aligned dragons.
Add a +1/2 bonus to Stealth and Sleight of Hand checks to steal or hide objects.
Add a +1/2 bonus to the damage of spells or spell-like abilities that deal damage of the same energy type as the sorcerer’s draconic bloodline breath weapon.

entries.name: Yaddithian
entries.description: Yaddithian: modificatori {'con': 2, 'int': 2, 'wis': -2}, taglia None, velocita' 20 ft. Tratti razziali: Darkvision; Defensive Abilities; Claws; Rugose; Cosmic Mind (Ex); Long-Lived (Ex).

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Yaddithians can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Defensive Abilities
traits.text: Yaddithians have cold resistance 5 and the no breath ability.

traits.name: Claws
traits.text: A Yaddithian has two claws that deal 1d4 points of damage each.

traits.name: Rugose
traits.text: A Yaddithian gains a +1 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Cosmic Mind (Ex)
traits.text: A Yaddithian gets a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge and Spellcraft checks. A yaddithian spellcaster who would store spells in a spellbook or familiar instead stores those spells in its mind (but must expend the normal resources to learn new spells).

traits.name: Long-Lived (Ex)
traits.text: Yaddithians live for thousands of years; they gain no benefit or penalty from aging and are immune to magical aging effects.
